notes.title: Patch notes - July 15th 2019
notes.content:
Patch notes - July 15th  2019

New troop incoming!

Engineers across the realms marvel at the latest in Stronghold-siege technology. Its engine whirs as it stomps forward to battle. The Warbot is ready for war and available now to all factions! Try it today!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33907518/310d203cf599e49c44021cb6be431514c7c872df.png[/img]

[b]1. NEW MERCENARY: [/b]Warbot! This arrival from another dimension boasts a devastating beam weapon that obliterates enemy troops and structures alike. You can only field one Warbot at a time, and they're costly to bring to the table, but their effectiveness cannot be denied! Try one out today!

[b]2. BUG FIX: [/b]Several bug fixes to make the Undying Horror better behave itself.

[b]3. BUG FIX: [/b]The Dark Shroud now correctly shows stats when TIPS are turned on.

[b]4. BUG FIX:[/b] Fixed an issue where the AI would stop deploying troops in Skirmish and Trials matches.

[b]5. LEVEL THREE POLISHING: [/b]After months of blood, sweat, tears and elbow grease, level three is finally ready to be shared with the world!!!! Nah, just kidding... it's still as imaginary as it ever was...
w00t!

notes.title: Patch notes - June 20th 2019
notes.content:
Patch notes - June 20th 2019

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33907518/e64c8eeab3b7880f81b2727892cfe0e41e5619b2.png[/img]

[b]1. HOTFIX[/b] The AI would occasionally stop deploying troops after some form of AI mental breakdown. This is now fixed.
[b]
2. LICH UPDATE.[/b] Lich stat change: Starting Health was 200/250/300/450 and is now 150/200/250/350. Mana Cost was 6 and is now 4.

3. We have a new artist whose "urgent" first day task was to complete the polishing of level 3. Oh how we laughed...

That's all folks!

notes.title: Patch Notes - June 14th, 2019
notes.content:
Patch notes - June 14th  2019

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33907518/8add13234c410436ac8a5fd8ced97a7273247142.png[/img]

Just a few small updates in this build...

1. [b]FIX[/b] for Undying Horrors flying off the edge of the Castle Grounds tabletop.

2. [b]TEXT CHAT UPDATE[/b]: Player name text is now assigned a color to help 
differentiate it from the body of the message. We've also added a DATE STAMP (UTC) to each message as it's posted. You can toggle the date stamp on/off in the text chat settings

3. [b]MASK DISPLAY UPDATE:[/b] We've updated the Mask Display in the REALM to help future-proof it for upcoming additions and to better support leaderboard competitions. 

4. [b]LEVEL THREE POLISHING:[/b] we've switched to a finer grain of sandpaper. I can now see my face in it. I look gorgeous!

notes.title: Patch notes - June 7th 2019
notes.content:
Patch notes - st1.0.332(10) / oc1.0.90(10) - June 7th  2019

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33907518/f0eb508de277d5a0514f889f93a4fe4714d7cd07.png[/img]

1. [b]NEW MERCENARY:[/b] The Undying Horror! This flying monstrosity does not know when to quit! When shot down from the sky, it will revert to its cocoon form only to be reborn seconds later if not quickly dispatched! Try out this pricey new troop in any of the factions you choose to play!

2.[b] NEW FEATURE:[/b] Non-VR Text Chat! We've introduced V1.0 of our text chat system for NON-VR players. Text Chat currently supports a GLOBAL channel, as well as a chat channel only for players in your current arena. 

3. [b]NEW FEATURE[/b]: Rift and Vive controller labeling. To help new players, we've labeled the control mappings for your Rift / Vive controllers by default. If you prefer a more minimalist approach, you can turn off the labels from the SETTINGS --> CONTROLS.

4. [b]NEW DEFAULT VR SETTING:[/b] The troop QUICK SELECT feature (left/right on the right stick or trackpad) has been disabled by default in an attempt to make new players aware of the DEPLOY MENU (the pop up menu where you can select troops, spells, etc.). We have seen that new VR players would often find QUICK SELECT before finding the DEPLOY MENU and would therefore assume this was the only way of selecting troops, towers, spells, etc. QUICK SELECT can be re-enabled in SETTINGS --> CONTROLS for players who enjoy this feature. 

5. [b]ARENA RULES UPDATE:[/b] Winner stays on NO LONGER! In an attempt to give players in social arenas more opportunity to play, we have scrapped the "winner stays on" rule. Now, when a match is over, the next two players in the queue will be invited to play.

6. [b]STAT UPDATE: BEHEMOTHS[/b] will now only ever hit a max of 6 troops in a single melee attack. REAVERS will only hit a max of 5.
7. XP gained from killing Necrospawn has been SUBSTANTIALLY reduced to stop BEHEMOTHS and other troops 'feeding' off of them to level up.

8. [b]LEVEL THREE POLISHING[/b] has reached new heights of shininess. We now believe that the level actually reflects more light than actually hits it. We appear to have broken the laws of physics and we're ever so proud...

notes.title: Patch Notes - 30th May, 2019
notes.content:
Data Update Notes - 30th May, 2019

SHAMBLING HULKS RE-BALANCE! is now live!

Hi all! Today we release a balance update for the Undead's SHAMBLING HULKS!

• Tower damage (per star) BEFORE the change was 250/280/310/340 
• Tower damage (per star) AFTER the change is 180/220/220/250 
• Time between attacks (per star) BEFORE the change was 3.7/3.55/3.4/3.25 
• Time between attacks (per star) AFTER the change is 4.65/4.45/4.25/4.1
• New DPS (as seen in Codex) is now 56, down from 111!

The changes are intended to bring the Hulk much more in line with Giants on a DPS per mana cost basis.

Thanks, and let us know what you think!

notes.title: Patch notes - May 28th, 2019
notes.content:
Patch notes - st1.0.322(9) / oc1.0.84(9) / vp1.0.33 - May 28th, 2019

notes.title: Patch notes - May 24th, 2019

Patch notes - st1.0.314(9) / oc1.0.80(9) - May 24th, 2019

1. An [b]ANNOUNCEMENTS PAGE[/b] has been implemented so we can tell you stuff in game!

notes.title: Patch Notes - May 22nd, 2019
notes.content:
Patch notes - PC (ST 1.0.308 (8)), RIFT (OC 1.0.76(8)) - May 22nd, 2019

This update addresses some balance issues... Read on!

1. FLESH LOBBERS have been nerfed. They now level up more slowly and have had their 3 star stats reduced somewhat. Remember!  Lobbers level up by regenerating their health, so don't do small amounts of damage to them! It only helps them level up!

2. WITCHES have been nerfed. Their attack range and movement speed have both been reduced. 

3. ALL DEMONS have been buffed! Leveling for all Demon troops was somewhat broken. They all now level up more quickly!

4. I know I said I would no longer comment on fictitious Level 3's graphics, but, man... they're looking soooooo good.

Let us know what you think! Did we nerf too far? Not enough? As usual, thanks all for the feedback!

notes.title: Version 1.0 is here - Patch Notes - May 16th, 2019
notes.content:
Today, May 16th, we've officially left early access behind and have released version 1.0 of Tabletop Gods!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33907518/8f66c3c1715f2ceac28baba1b8d342ea25267fbb.png[/img]

[b]Launch Week![/b]

Coming with the full release, we've got a couple of events lined up that perhaps some of you will be interested in. Starting today, Tabletop Gods will be free to play from May 16th to 19th! Head over to our store page and download it for free! You can play our free weekend until midnight on May 19th on Steam! Hop into the game and give it a whirl. 
We do have a Discord as well that makes it slightly easier for people to find a match during the quieter times of the day. We also talk about a lot of strategies, updates, future content, and other random things throughout the day. You can find that at discord.gg/tabletopgods

[b]SALE![/b]

Along with the launch of our official release, we're going on sale! For the first week of full release, Tabletop Gods will be 25% off for anyone who purchases on Steam, Viveport, or the Oculus Store!

Going on from there, the fine folks over at Humble Bundle have given us a nice spot in their storefront where you can get two copies of the game for $29.99. That means you save 25% on both copies if you buy two!

[b]Competition for Exclusive Content[/b]

We’ve been talking about holding a tournament or contest in game for a long time and we have finally decided to do it! We’ll be using our weekly in-game leaderboard to give  each player a chance at winning up to three unique masks, available to earn only during this limited time contest.

Starting next Monday, May 20th, we will be holding a seven day contest where your position on our leaderboard could earn you a special prize. The following Sunday, May 26th, at midnight, when the weekly leaderboard rolls over for a new week, all players that end in the top 100 places on the leaderboard will all earn up to three unique masks to wear in game. 

The third place prize will be awarded to the top 100 players at the end of the week. They will receive this exclusive Witch Hat!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33907518/193ce5bf8172f91d413ebc3995835d3226d07165.png[/img]

The second place prize, in addition to the third place prize will be awarded to the top 50 players at the end of the week. They’ll receive this exclusive Cogbot mask!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33907518/9d15391903e115201c4543397d1940fd397d8b4d.png[/img]

Finally, the top 10 players, in addition to the second and third place prize masks, will receive this one time only, exclusive, exceptionally rare War Bear mask.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33907518/43697c2a74cf8fad0d2969a5d15a949051a375bf.png[/img]

[i]How do I compete?[/i]

It’s easy! All you have to do is play Tabletop Gods against other players in public arenas. All points that you earn in public arenas are scored on our weekly leaderboard. Starting Monday, May 20th, all points earned will be counted on a fresh leaderboard. On the following Monday, May 27th, when the learboard has rolled over for a new week, all players that ended in the top 100 places on the leaderboard will instantly receive their prizes!

[i]Who can compete?[/i]

Anyone that is not a developer on our team that owns the game on either Steam, Viveport, or Oculus Home. All you need is to be able to play throughout the week of the contest.

[i]Will you ever do this again?[/i]

Absolutely! If this contest is met with enough positive feedback, we will definitely consider holding more, similar contests.

[b]Weekly Meetups![/b]

Each week we get together to live stream and compete against each other for the weekly title of MVP.  The prize is bragging rights and a shiny gold title in our Discord server. This is only the beginning of what we hope to do. As our player count increases, we'd love to host more formal contests with prizes. Like we said before, the number of different strategies myself and the community have come up with over the last few months range from precise and effective to "so crazy it works". 

Here's a clip from one of those meetups:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ebGXE_LSMr0&t=2s

Some of our favourite moments come from players shouting with excitement as the games proceed into a tense Sudden Death after the normal timer expires. It's a lot of fun to get together with the players each week, and we want even more players to get in on the fun.

[b]What's next?[/b]

We still have ideas planned for new features, such as new troops, spells and traps and other things to keep gameplay fresh. As more players become interested in taking part in our weekly event, we will be hosting more events to reach out to players in different time zones who can't always make it to our usual meetup. 

Give it a go! There'll be plenty of frenetic action for everyone during our free weekend. This weekend only!

[b]PATCH NOTES[/b]

Patch notes - v1.0.301 - May 16th, 2019

1. FULL RELEASE! We're out of Steam Early Access and into full release! w00t!

2. Many many bug fixes, graphical tweaks and performance enhancements under the hood to improve your game play experience.

3. In single player, the game now pauses when you open the PAUSE / SETTINGS menu. Go figure!

4. Three COMPETITION MASKS have been added! As per the LEVEL UP masks, you can view these from the REALM. Just hit the button at the top right of the Mask Display to switch to the COMPETITION MASKS. These masks can only be unlocked during Leaderboard Competitions (for placing highly on the weekly leaderboard). 

[i]We'd like to say thanks to all our players during Early Access for helping us get this far! Your contributions and banter on Discord are always appreciated! This week we have a FREE WEEKEND, Sale AND the Leaderboard Competition with the chance to earn those cool new masks, so jump on in! As always, we'll see you on the Tabletop![/i]

notes.title: Patch notes - v0.9.277 - April 17th, 2018
notes.content:
Patch notes - v0.9.277 - April 17th, 2018

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33907518/de89173550a6ddaaced29451dcf41035e6147cc8.png[/img]

[b]1.[/b] Trials Mode matches now have a RESTART option so you can instantly restart a match that you're hopelessly losing ;).

[b]2. [/b][u]VR Players:[/u]
    a) More control options: Four different options for what the "forward" direction is - i.e. what direction you'll move when you push up on the left controller: (Option 1, the new default) Your facing direction, (Option 2, the previous default) The direction arrow on the floor, (Options 3+4) your left or right hand pointing direction (some people like this method, apparently). We've updated the SETTINGS screen to accommodate this addition.

    b) You can have the option to dock the deploy menu to your off-hand! Docked is the default setting

[b]3.[/b] [u]Non-VR Players[/u]
    a) ESC key now takes you back to the previous menu page rather than the QUIT page

    b) Removed personal space settings. We figured they weren't very important for non-VR players.

[b]4.[/b] AI Gods now have their correct names in Skirmish and Trials modes. 

[b]5.[/b] [u]TROOP updates:[/u]
    a) Demon Mage's attack area has been reduced

    b) Demon Mage's Codex stats now reflect the correct data :)

    c) A Demon Lord bug in its flight logic has been fixed

    d) The Demon Lord's melee attack is now arc limited (i.e. it can no longer hit enemies behind it!)

    e) The max number of targets that a Behemoth can inflict damage on in a single attack has been reduced to 6.

    f) The Behemoth's guarding behavior has been improved.

    g) War Clerics following behavior has been improved

    h) War Clerics healing ability and  XP gain has been nerfed.

    i) Archers XP gain has been nerfed.

    j) Ice Golems XP gain has been nerfed.

    k) Witch's attack range and AoE, speed, turn speed, health and curse duration have all been buffed to varying degrees.

    l) We fixed an issue where skeletons were dying unexpectedly.

[b]6.[/b] Distance indicators on ranged towers, troops and spells is now more accurate

[b]7.[/b] multiple AI improvements

[b]8.[/b] Demon table geometry has had subtle changes to allow easier placement of towers.

[b]9.[/b] Light maps in all arenas have been improved

[b]10. Level 3 is a lie. Always has been. Always will be. But MAN.... It tastes so good...[/b]

notes.title: Patch notes - v0.9.263 - Mar 21st, 2019

notes.title: BRAND NEW FACTION!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33907518/284db80162240924f4bd510a7f1322269b62dad6.png[/img]

Patch notes - v0.9.248 - Mar 13th, 2019

1. THE DEMONS HAVE ARRIVED! Behold! A whole new faction for you to take to war! The Demons are a race from another dimension, who have for a long maintained a steady peace with Humankind. But, the machinations of the Dark God and the uprising of the Netherrealm has brought all three factions to war. The new demon troops are as follows:

Reavers - A melee unit with a cleave attack that excels at knocking down structures.

Worms - The Demon's ranged sentry unit. Its attacks don't a great deal of immediate damage, but they do leave a their victims suffering from a NASTY health-sapping damage-over-time effect. 

Behemoths - The Demon faction's 'heavy' unit, but the reverse of the Undead's Shambling Hulks! This guy ONLY attacks troops, not structures, mopping up swathes of weaker enemies. An excellent guard troop, he'll defend nearby friendly troops or, failing that, retreat to the nearest friendly Stronghold. 

Mage - She has a long charge up which  then rips open a rift in space that starts attacking nearby troops and structures. She'll hold the rift open as long as there are targets close enough to attack. 

Demon Lord - Flies from battle-to-battle, covering large distances quickly. When in range of his target he'll smash down onto them with a BOOM! on enemy units.

And, along with the new troops come three new Demon structures:

Rage Totem - 'Enrages' any friendly troops deployed within its range. Enraged troops lose a little health, but become faster, attack harder, and hit more frequently. 

Vortex Cannon - Attacks enemy troops. Deal less damage than the human Cannon Tower, but has a larger damage splash radius.

Rift Bombard - Short ranged, but great for destroying the enemy's structures.

2. NEW TABLETOP BATTLEFIELD! The demons bring with them a brand-new tabletop battlefield to fight on! The Void Temple has multiple lanes that you'll be challenged to protect making the decision as to whether you should defend, or go on the attack, that much more tricky.

3. NEW TRIALS! With the arrival of the Demon faction, we've added two new trials, featuring the aforementioned faction, for you to enjoy. There will be more trials on the way later , so stay tuned! 

4. INFO PANEL! In nonVR, players can now see information about their troops, towers, traps and spells as they play. This information is intended primarily for new players, but may give existing players some hints and tips as to how to improve their game. You can turn toggle the info panel on/off by checking the INFO button. VR players will be getting similar functionality soon(TM).

5. Level 3 apparently morphed into a brand new table! Phew! Well done QA for polishing up those graphics! We're currently looking for a new level 3 that's in need of some polishing...

notes.title: Patch notes - v0.9.243 - Mar 4th, 2019
notes.content:
Patch notes - v0.9.243 - Mar 4th, 2019

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33907518/82d56380a53fde6554739562837967cb655c5b06.png[/img]

1. NEW FEATURE: LEADERBOARDS All multiplayer matches throughout the week are now tabulated and added to the Weekly Leaderboards, which can be viewed in your Realm (just to the right of the main menu scroll) or in a Multiplayer Arena (click on the LEADERBOARDS on the top-right of the arena display). Leaderboards reset each week on Sunday at midnight UTC. The player with the most points is crowned reigning champion and will receive a crown that floats above their mask for the duration of the week, showing off their glorious status to all challengers!

2. NEW FEATURE: MORTAL CAM Spectators can now get close and personal with a "troops-eye view" of the action on the table. Just point at one of the eye icons floating above the table and click to transport yourself, Ant-Man-styley, onto the table! NonVR players can press ESC to cancel Mortal Cam mode. VR players can press most any button on their controllers to cancel.

3. Your Realm has been rearranged by your minions while you were away at the battlefield. The Leaderboard and Mask selection are now on each side of the Realm's Main Menu Scroll for easier access.

4. Practice mode has been renamed to "Skirmish", which, let's face it, is a better description of what it really is...

5. Ever-so-slightly reduced the range of Tower Destroyers and Pestilence Launchers.

6. Updated Microphone Audio system for improved behaviour across as many systems as possible.

7. Various minor bug fixes, including updates on lighting through the arenas.

8. Progress on the graphics for Level 3 is going as well as usual. Will it ever be complete? Who knows? WHO KNOWS!?!?!?!?!
Known Issues:
- Microphones not picking up any audio - We have seen issues with people who have their Windows Microphone levels set to 50 (out of 100) or less, where the default voice thresholds will not pick up any audio (other than perhaps some hefty shouting). This is fixable by either moving your microphone levels up to 60 or 70 percent in Windows, and/or lowering your Mic Threshold at the bottom right of the "Players in Arena" menu while in an Arena.

notes.title: Patch notes - v0.9.223 - Feb 22nd, 2019
notes.content:
To the victor, go the spoils! Achievements are officially launched.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33907518/e93bb77837b64ec683110e751d097cc398f37313.png[/img]

Patch notes - v0.9.223 - Feb 22nd, 2019

1. [b]ACHIEVEMENTS![/b] A whole host of challenges have just been released in the form of Achievements! Some of you busier players may have unlocked a few of them already, but there will be plenty more for you have a go at! Plus, we'll be releasing more achievements in future updates! notes.title: Patch notes - v0.9.207 - Feb 15th, 2019
notes.content:
Patch notes - v0.9.207 - Feb 15th, 2019

1. Small translation fixes for Italian and French languages
2. There was no time to do any extra work on Level 3.

notes.title: Patch notes - v0.9.204 - Feb 14th, 2019
notes.content:
Happy Valentines Day!

1. NEW POWER SPELL! FORTIFY! Cast this spell on a single or group of structures and grant them a shield that deflects all but the strongest of blows. As an added extra, each structure also gains a mighty beam weapon to smite its aggressors! And it starts each round precharged... hmmmm...

2. FRIENDS! Now you can officially have in-game friends (just like real-life ones!). Your TTG-playing Steam friends will be automatically added to your friend list, but you can also send a friend invite to players you meet in Arenas. Finding your friends to play against is as easy as selecting them from the Friends list and jumping into their arena!

3. PRIVATE ARENAS! With the advent of the Friends feature, you can now create PRIVATE arenas that only friends of players in that arena can see and join. There's nothing like being anti-socially social!

4. Practice Match's EASY difficulty level is now easier. There's nothing worse than buying a new game and then being ground into the dirt by something that purports to be a "practice" mode. EASY is now the default setting and has been nerfed to allow new players to become familiar with the game without getting their asses kicked all over the place. YMMV.

5. Miscellaneous minor bug fixes that we doubt you'd even notice but should make things run just a little more smoothly. 

6. We're happy to report that the graphics on Level 3, after having received a considerable tightening up, are coming along nicely.

notes.title: Patch notes - v0.9.195 - Feb 7th, 2019
notes.content:
Patch notes - v0.9.195 - Feb 7th, 2019

1. [b]NEW TRAP! MANA CATALYST! [/b]Enemies who trigger your Mana Catalyst trap are imbued with Mana which you collect if you can kill them in time! Nice! Whenever you receive Mana, you'll see it fly towards you (which makes losing a Stronghold just a wee bit prettier and easier to stomach, maybe...)

2. [b]MINI-MAP HAS ARRIVED![/b] To give our Non-VR players a little more table-awareness, there's now a handy mini-map that you can resize / turn off or reposition (defaults to "m" and "n" keys respectively, but you can rebind them). VR players - if you take a peek on your desktop while playing a match, you'll also see the mini-map on your monitor, which is nice for VR streamers and people watching you play. Stay tuned for more spectator / streamer features coming soon!

3. The Codex now shows reset times for traps. Phew!

4. Dark Shroud now lasts 15 seconds instead of 20, and its duration is now displayed in the Codex. Who EVER thought 20 was a good idea?!?!

5. Miscellaneous bug and localization fixes.

6. Practice Mode now defaults to EASY, but there will be some rebalancing on Practice coming soon!

7. The graphics on Level 3 have gone all Picasso, which is interesting...

notes.title: Patch notes - v0.9.188 - Feb 1st, 2019
notes.content:
1. Key binding! Non-VR players can now remap their keyboard controls from the controls screen in the Settings menu.

2. Languages Added! You can now switch your language in the Settings screen. Supported languages currently include English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Korean, and Mandarin. For VR players, we are aware that screen showing your controller mapping has not yet been localized. We're working on it :)

3. Update to the way the game uses the mic. Sensitivity has been increased and now players can change the cut-off threshold for their mic. Please contact us if this change causes any issues for you.

3. Reduced the XP required for Skeletons to level up, making a level 3 skeleton more than just a pipe-dream.

4. Improved graphical quality throughout the entirety of Level 3. Cowbell now replaces oldskool sparkle...

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.9.172 - Jan 29th, 2019
notes.content:
Build notes for build v0.9.172 - Jan 29th, 2019

- Stopped the game from trying to run at thousands of frames per second in non-VR
- Tightened up the graphics in level 3.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Jan 25, 2019
notes.content:
Build notes for build v0.9.171 - Jan 25th, 2019

- Added a shiny new death animation for the lich!

- Prevented players from entering arenas created by players on different build version numbers.
- Fixed an issue with the sudden death notification in Non-VR
- Fixed an issue with some units hanging around between matches in rare cases.
- Fixed a bug that occurred when both players placed towers on the same spot. Towers now correctly explode if they are placed over enemy towers.
- Improved our handling and behaviour for non-english languages.
- Third Level graphics now able to see through time.

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.9.168 - Jan 24th, 2019
notes.content:
- NEW TACTICAL SPELL Blossom is bursting its way on to the battlefield! Replacing Stasis or Harden, Blossom grants a short time effect that causes all units to explode when they die and damage your enemies!

- Improved the alignment of the mana counter in VR
- Witches dying should no longer hurt your ears! 
- A bug fix for some VR issues including a height issue and the controllers not inputting occasionally.
- Minor invisible bug fixes to keep improving the state of the game. 
- Tightened up the graphics on level 3.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Jan 18th, 2019.
notes.content:
Build notes for build v0.9.150 - Jan 18th, 2019.

- Fixed issues with automatically determining VR platform on launch
- Added additional logging to help debug issues with VR controls
- Tightened up the graphics on level 3 (edited)

notes.title: Patch notes - v0.9.149 - Jan 14th, 2019.
notes.content:
[b]v0.9.149[/b]

- Cleaned up some issues on the human arena where units would end up shooting trees instead of enemies, and prevented the pestilence launcher from firing over the village-side buildings.

- Made anti-aliasing off by default for VR players (Hopefully improving VR performance and reducing stutter)

- Improved the explanation text on the "quick match" screen.

- Introduced some fixes that will help prevent troops hanging around after a match (in rare cases)

- Fixed some of the water effects for the fountain.

- Fixed some internal issues that had been producing unfriendly but seemingly inconsequential errors.

- Tightened up the graphics on Level 3.

notes.title: January 8, 2019, build notes for v0.9.145
notes.content:
Day 2 patch anyone?

- Improved the bomber explosion.
- Prettied up our Splash screen with appropriate icons and spacing!
- Corrected banners on the undead arena.
- Quality and Graphics settings are now saved and work correctly on every load up.
- Fixed a minor issue with pointing through the bridge on the undead level.
- Fixed an issue where dark shroud made some units look metallic.
- Fixed an issue in Trials > Orderly Destruction where it wasn't actually failing correctly some of the time.
- Fixed an issue where the results scroll could become stuck open forever.
- Fixed a completely different issue where the main menu scroll would just never show up.
- Fixed an issue where sometimes the clients and server list got out of sync after multiple matches.
- Fixed some minor under-the-hood behaviours that were slowing things down a bit.
- Tightened up graphics on level 3.
